title: robots.txt disallowed /events/new as a prefix, which would hide every public event whose slug starts with new

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-urls finder). `Disallow: /events/new` in app/robots.ts is a prefix rule, so /events/new-moon-circle or /events/newcomers-night would be blocked from every crawler and AI engine the file welcomes. MEASURED ON PROD: 0 live event slugs start with `new` today, so this was latent, not leaking. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the rule is `/events/new$` (Google and Bing honour the anchor) plus `/events/new?` for the composer's own query forms.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/robots.ts","utf8");if(/"\/events\/new",/.test(s)||!/"\/events\/new\$",/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-654: robots.ts disallows the PREFIX /events/new, which also hides every public event whose slug starts with new (a $ anchor scopes it to the composer).");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change (checked by stashing the fix); passes with it.
